# Carts expire after one day

> follows [[MADR]]

## Context and Problem Statement

Abandoned carts hold stock.

## Considered Options

1. One hour
2. One day

## Decision Outcome

Chosen option: **one day**, because shoppers return the next morning.

### Consequences

- Bad: stock is held longer.
